subject: Mutual Action Plan — throughput evaluation & POC close timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@finbank.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial request — throughput MAP + acceptance criteria

Rachel / team,

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to formalize a Mutual Action Plan that covers: throughput benchmarking (sustained QPS and tokens/sec), tail/95th latency and TTFT for our 2-prod workload, and a simple unit-economics projection for a 90-day POC.

High-level constraints:
- Model: finbank/gpt-alpha-13b (16k context)
- Typical prompt length: 150 tokens, avg response: 120 tokens
- Peak concurrency target: 220 concurrent users (burst to 350)
- Required production TTFT target: <= 1.2s for first token under canary traffic

Can you share a proposed MAP with specific benchmarks, measurement methodology, and a recommended schedule to close the POC by end-of-year? Also include any attachments or config stubs you need from our side.

Jordan
FinBank — Head of Platform
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@finbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — throughput MAP + acceptance criteria

Jordan — thanks, this is clear and actionable. Attaching a draft MAP and our throughput evaluation plan for your review (FinBank_MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx; throughput_eval_plan.md). Below are the key items we propose: 

1) Acceptance criteria (must pass to sign-off POC):
   - Sustained QPS: 1,000 sustained requests/sec (avg) for 30 minutes with 99% availability during the run
   - Throughput: 400k tokens/sec aggregate across the cluster (measured steady-state)
   - Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 180ms (per token) for tail of requests; TTFT (time-to-first-token) <= 1.2s on canary
   - Concurrency validation: maintain target QoS at 220 concurrent connections; handle bursts to 350 with graceful degradation (fallback to smaller quantized model if required)

2) Measurement methodology:
   - Baseline run: 10-minute warmup, then 30-minute steady-state at target QPS with synthetic traffic matching your prompt/response lengths.
   - Tools: k6 for request generation, internal perf harness to capture tokens/sec and KV cache hit rates, and pprof traces for tail latency analysis.
   - Metrics captured: tokens/sec (aggregate and per-GPU), sustained QPS, 50/95/99 latencies, TTFT, CPU/GPU utilization, and tail memory spikes.

3) Unit economics snapshot (POC projection):
   - Measured cost assumptions (approx): GPU instance cost $4.50/hr per A100-equivalent; average effective utilization during bench: 72%
   - Throughput-derived compute cost: ~ $0.85 per 1M tokens served (GPU-only compute), infra & networking add ~20% => $1.02 per 1M tokens
   - Expected unit cost at target load (incl. infra/overhead): ~$0.00102 per token (i.e., $1.02/1,000,000)
   - 90-day POC estimate (assumes 50M tokens total processed during POC): ~ $51 (compute) + overheads — note: this is POC-scale accounting for bench runs only; production numbers will scale differently.

4) Proposed schedule and close timeline:
   - Week 1 (Nov 8–12): exchange config stubs, validate dataset/traffic shape
   - Week 2 (Nov 15–19): baseline runs + initial canary (light traffic)
   - Week 3 (Nov 22–26): sustained runs and regression checks; unit-econ recalculation
   - Week 4 (Nov 29–Dec 3): run final acceptance, handoff to CS for production onboarding; target contract signature by Dec 10

Items we need from FinBank: sample prompt set (anonymized), authentication for our perf harness, and confirmation of acceptable SLO thresholds for TTFT.

I've cc'd Kar by request — Kar, Neha: can you review the measurement plan and the proposed schedule? Marcus, flag anything obvious on unit-econ calc.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-04T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — throughput MAP + acceptance criteria

Quick notes from infra/bench side: 
- Add a sustained 60-minute run at 75% target QPS to capture thermal effects. Some models show 10–12% throughput drift after long runs.
- We should measure tokens/sec both per-GPU and per-request to derive per-concurrency cost. Plan to attach bench-config-stubs.json that maps sequence_length distributions and the k6 script parameters.
- For the burst scenario (350 concurrent), recommend a graceful-fallback policy: route 10% of traffic to a quantized 7b variant to preserve latency for critical calls. We'll include that in the MAP as an automated fallback rule.

I'll prepare the bench config and small script fragments.

— Kar
From: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@finbank.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@finbank.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — throughput MAP + acceptance criteria

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of follow-ups: 
- Can you provide an explicit cost projection for a 90-day POC that includes bench runs + expected daily traffic (we estimate ~500k tokens/day outside bench windows)?
- For the fallback to 7b, what impact do you expect on unit economics (rough delta in $/1M tokens)?

If those answers look reasonable we can lock Week 2 for baseline runs (Nov 15). Also confirm whether Redwood needs any on-prem access or if all benchmarking can run against the hosted POC cluster.

Jordan
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Cole <jordan.cole@finbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial request — throughput MAP + acceptance criteria

Jordan — confirming the plan and answering your questions below.

90-day POC cost projection (detailed):
- Bench runs (total 5x sustained runs at 30–60 minutes each): estimated GPU hours = 5 runs * 2 hrs effective per run * 8 A100-equivalent GPUs = 80 GPU-hours -> GPU cost ~$360 (at $4.50/hr)
- Daily baseline traffic (500k tokens/day * 90 days = 45M tokens): compute cost ~ $45.9 (at $1.02 per 1M tokens)
- Overheads (network, storage, infra ops, monitoring): estimated 25% -> ~$101
- Total POC projected cost (rounded): $360 + $45.9 + $101 = ~$507 (Redwood-managed; discounts for committed Reserved capacity not included)

Fallback economics: switching 10% traffic to quantized 7b reduces GPU-hours for that slice by ~55% and lowers unit cost for those tokens to ~$0.00046 per token (~$0.46 per 1k tokens), so blended unit cost at target load improves marginally (~3–4% reduction on aggregate depending on exact mix). We'll include a sensitivity table in unit-econ-summary-cc.csv.

Hosted vs on-prem: all benchmarking can be run against a Redwood-hosted POC cluster. If you require on-prem testing we can plan an air-gapped run, but that will extend the schedule by 2 weeks for provisioning and security sign-off.

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm sample prompt set and auth for our perf harness by Nov 12 (if not possible, move baseline to Nov 22)
- Kar: attach bench-config-stubs.json and push perf scripts to the shared Drive folder
- Marcus/Neha: finalize unit-econ CSV and sanity-check config for the canary

If we get confirmation this week, I’ll update FinBank_MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx and lock in Nov 15 as baseline start.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: FinBank_MAP_Timeline_v1.xlsx (schedules), throughput_eval_plan.md (methodology), bench-config-stubs.json (bench parameters), unit-econ-summary-cc.csv (sensitivity)
